title: Finishing the last lesson of any Journey marks the member's enrolment complete

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: journey_enrollments.completed_at was written only by tryCompleteJourney (lib/quest/complete.ts), which runs from practice logs and only for ranked_eligible plans. The lesson check-off (completeJourneyLessonAction) fired the journey_complete reward event but never stamped the enrolment, so a member who finished a paid, Space or member-built Journey stayed active forever: holding an enroll_cap seat (free-enrol-gate and paid.ts count completed_at is null, so a capped Journey stayed Full), counting on the people meter, and sitting in the drip and daily-prompt crons. Fixed 2026-11-17: lib/journeys/runs.ts stampEnrollmentComplete (idempotent, only open rows, best-effort) runs when the check-off's events include journey_complete. Not changed: unticking a lesson after finishing leaves the stamp, as tryCompleteJourney does.

verify.note: Fails if the lesson check-off stops stamping completed_at on journey_complete, or the stamp helper stops being idempotent.
